# Canonical control migration study

This is a curated translation of the existing `examples/operation_algorithms`
project at commit `93aff07ee58fb64ea72d48009fbec98a6238028a`, with repository
and Reference access. Only `estimation.qli` changes: replace the private
one-active-arm `qif` helper with canonical `controlled(U)(c,q)`, use static
`power(U,k)` and runtime `inverse(fixed qft2/qft3)`. Keep the other sources,
manifest, copyright and licenses. No generic QFT is attempted.

The complete source was prepared in `/private/tmp` before checking. The actual
finite-profile refusal is preserved. This context/session metadata was recorded
after that observation and before finite controlled lowering; it is not a blind
model-authoring trial, probability claim, proof or guarantee admission.

The next implementation must keep exact trees, ordered control/target axes,
both owners including zero-width targets, eager argument effects, independent
Controlled access, original providers/Meanings and fresh native evidence.
The existing finite capacities remain; no largest-size case is generated.

The copied original example README is retained byte-for-byte as
`attempt-01/README.before.txt`: its relative links belong to its original
example directory. It is historical prose, not a new rendered chapter.

The subsequent active-example migration is prepared as `attempt-02` before
checking. It retains the same canonical QPE source and additionally translates
the two interference clients and the two-iteration amplification description.
The before-edit contract is Issue #33 comment 6030889219; the first snapshot
and every original observation remain unchanged.
